title: Sarah Lacy: 'his book is the explanation of why and an answer on how to fix what … all of us mostly unintentionally broke'
summary: Hours before hosting Eric's first Bay Area launch event at Best Bookstore SF, journalist and Pando/TechCrunch founder Sarah Lacy publishes a launch-eve personal essay on LinkedIn linking her 2011 TechCrunch arc to Lean Startup and framing Incorruptible as a generational reckoning for the dot-com cohort she came up in.
blockquote: His book is the explanation of why and an answer on how to fix what he, me, we, our entire generation of Internet people who largely moved here in the dot com bubble or a little later too, what all of us mostly unintentionally broke in the world.
attribution_title: Co-founder & CEO, Best Bookstore Corp; founder of Pando; former 2nd TechCrunch editor
